ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam')
ወኀለፈ: ኀለፈ — and he passed, went by (ወ- + 3ms perfect)
፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants') · 'one' as a pronoun, 'one … another' (ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'one tells another'; ch. 53)
ግብጽ: ግብጽ — Egypt (proper name; genitive after construct)
ዘንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — of the king (ዘ- genitive + noun)
ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him')
ወበጽሐ: በጽሐ — and he reached (ወ- + 3ms perfect, b-ṣ-ḥ)
ወሰገደ: ሰገደ — and he bowed down (ወ- + 3ms perfect, s-g-d)
ለንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — to the king, for the king (ለ- + noun) · marking the object, doubled by a suffix on the verb (ይሕምይዎ ለንጉሥ 'they revile the king') or by a suffix on a noun (ሐሚዮቱ ለንጉሥ 'the reviling of the king')
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered')
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
ቦኑ: ቦ — is there? is it so that? (existential ቦ + interrogative -ኑ)
ዘርኢከ: ርእየ — which you saw (ዘ- relative + 2ms perfect, G)
ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
ወአውሥአ: አውሥአ — and he answered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity') · 'of the world', the owner after an anticipating suffix (ብርሃኖ ለዓለም 'the light of the world')
ኀቤከ: ኀበ — at, with, to (preposition, form ኀቤ- + -ከ 'you', 2ms)
ወነዋ: ነዋ — and behold, here is (ወ- + interjection ነዋ)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
ዘትብል: ብህለ — what you say (ዘ- + 2ms imperfect ትብል, b-h-l)
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?)
ኀለፈት: ኀለፈ — it passed away (3fs perfect, ḫ-l-f)
ሠሉስ: ሠሉስ — third; Tuesday (adjective/noun; ሠሉስ ዕለት 'the third day')
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
ኀይለ: ኀይል — strength (noun, accusative ኀይለ) · construct 'host of' (ኀይለ ሰማይ 'host of heaven')
ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
መሬታዊያን: መሬታዊ — earthly ones (adjective, plural -ያን, used as noun)
ኮኑ: ኮነ — they became (3mp perfect, k-w-n) · 'so they were' in a simile (ከማሁ ኮኑ 'thus they were')
ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
ነፉስ: ነፋስ — wind (noun; spelled ነፉስ) · ነፉስ in በሰረገላ ነፉስ perhaps 'of wind, airy' (?)
ሀለዉ: ሀለወ — they were, they were there (3mp perfect, G, h-l-w)
ወማኅፈደ: ማኅፈድ — and tower (?) of (ወ- + noun, construct; 'stature' in ch. 31 is its figurative sense) (?)
ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
ወሐተቱ: ሐተተ — and they questioned, inquired (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḥ-t-t)
በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ወይቤሉነ: ብህለ — and they said to us (ወ- + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ + -ነ '1cp to us')
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
ሀለወት: ሀለወ — she was, she was present (3fs perfect, h-l-w)
ወትነብር: ነበረ — and she sits, dwells (ወ- + 3fs imperfect) · also 2ms 'and you will dwell' (ወትነብር ውስተ ብሔርነ)
ወአንተሰ: አንተ — and as for you (ወ- + 2ms pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
ኦንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — O king (ኦ vocative 'O' written onto the noun + ንጉሥ)
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
እምታሕተ: ታሕተ — from under, under (እም- + preposition ታሕተ)
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ
አበዊከ: አብ — your fathers (noun, plural አበው + -ka '2ms your')
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day')
እምእደ: እድ — from the hand of (እም- + noun, construct)
በመንፈሱ: መንፈስ — in his spirit (በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ለባዕድ: ባዕድ — to another, a strange one (ለ- + noun/adjective)
አውሥአ: አውሥአ — he answered (3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
በአይቴ: አይቴ — by what, in what (በ- + interrogative 'where, what')
ይክል: ከህለ — he is able (3ms imperfect, G, k-h-l; with infinitive)
ነሢኦታ: ነሥአ — taking her (infinitive ነሢኦት + -ኣ '3fs her' (written -ታ), accusative, n-ś-ʾ)
ለእግዝእትነ: እግዝእት — our lady, for/of our lady (ለ- + noun, fem. + -ነ '1cp our'; marks the object, doubled by the suffix of ነሢኦታ)
